organization.name: Asseco
organization.short_description:
Asseco Group is a prominent multinational federation specializing in Information Technology and enterprise software development. Founded in 1991 in Rzeszów, Poland, it has grown into one of the largest technology corporations listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange. With a presence in over 50 countries and a workforce of approximately 20,000 to 34,000 employees, Asseco operates through a network of independent companies, including its largest entity, Asseco Poland SA.

The company offers a diverse range of proprietary software solutions, with around 80% of its sales revenue coming from its own products. Key segments include Solutions for Finance, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Solutions for Public Institutions. Asseco also provides services such as system implementation, software development, IT consulting, and ongoing maintenance and support. Its solutions cater to various industries, including banking, public sector, healthcare, and fast-moving consumer goods, positioning Asseco as a trusted partner for organizations seeking high-quality, scalable software solutions.
